'''''Perpetuus''''' was an 80 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-long [[CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle/Legends|CSS-1 Corellian Star Shuttle]] which brought the newly-elected [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] to [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] following the end of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]] was going to include the name of the ''Perpetuus'' in his ''[[The Essential Guide to Episode I]]'', but the project was canceled and the name was never used elsewhere until the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Phantom Menace: The Expanded Visual Dictionary]]'' included the name next to an image of the vessel.
